native.gpio_profile: Actual GPIO device profile, unknown; digital pin is not a packet bus and has no universal baud or voltage.
native.gpio_pin: Required actual port/pin/package identity and ownership, unknown; unavailable package pins and alternate-function conflicts must be resolved.
native.gpio_wiring_source: Required actual peer wiring/voltage domains/load/pull resistors/isolation/contention and physical limits, unknown.
native.gpio_phase: Actual operating versus reset state. Reset defaults do not overwrite programmed application outputs.
native.gpio_direction: Actual pin mode, unknown. Qualified non-exception STM8TL reset proposes input only; alternate functions use a separate explicit technology.
native.gpio_reset_exception: Actual pin/package exception to reset configuration from datasheet, unknown; e.g. PA_CR1 reset differs. Never assume all reset pins float.
native.gpio_pull: Actual controller internal pull, unknown; reviewed STM8TL digital input supports NONE/UP, not universal pull-down.
native.gpio_drive: Actual output driver/pad kind. True open-drain is pin-specific, not inferred from register option.
native.gpio_active_low: Actual application polarity, unknown; electrical HIGH/LOW and functional active state are separate.
native.gpio_level: Actual electrical drive/read state, unknown; floating input is not automatically logicLOW or safe actuation.
native.gpio_input_mode: Actual input sampling/event mechanism, unknown. Output update does not require a slave address or input polling bound.
native.gpio_event: Actual selected interrupt sensitivity and controller support, unknown; no mandatory rising edge.
native.gpio_debounce_enabled: Actual hardware/software debounce enabled, unknown; no universal debounce0ms or10ms.
native.gpio_vdd_v: Actual operating GPIO supply/domain voltage, unknown; datasheet governs min/max and pin tolerance.3.3/5/24V are not universal GPIO defaults.
native.gpio_vil_max_v: Actual receiving maximum low-input voltage at matched supply/temperature/logic mode, unknown.
native.gpio_vih_min_v: Actual receiving minimum high-input voltage at matched supply/temperature/logic mode, unknown.
native.gpio_vol_max_v: Actual driving worst-case low voltage at the actual sink load, unknown; must meet receiving VIL.
native.gpio_voh_min_v: Actual driving worst-case high voltage at the actual source load, unknown; must meet receiving VIH.
native.gpio_sink_bound_ma: Actual safe per-pin sink-current bound for specified voltage, unknown; absolute maximum is not an operating default.
native.gpio_source_bound_ma: Actual safe per-pin source-current bound for specified voltage, unknown; not universal20mA.
native.gpio_sink_load_ma: Actual sink load, unknown; must fit per-pin limit and separately verified package/port aggregate.
native.gpio_source_load_ma: Actual source load, unknown; must fit pin and actual port/package aggregate.
native.gpio_pull_source: Actual external pull-up/down resistance/load/rise/fall/rail and leakage evidence, unknown; open-drain high state needs explicit pull network.
native.gpio_pull_ohms: Actual external resistor value, unknown; no universal4.7k resistor. An explicitly present resistor must be positive.
native.gpio_load_pf: Actual pad+wiring+peer load capacitance, unknown; no universal I2C400pF limit or timing default for GPIO.
native.gpio_rise_bound_ns: Actual pin transition upper bound at actual load/slew/drive conditions, unknown; nominal MCU clock does not prove this.
native.gpio_fall_bound_ns: Actual falling transition upper bound, unknown, separate from source/target software processing.
native.gpio_transition_source: Actual register-write/configuration sequence and intermediate-state/glitch/interrupt masking evidence, unknown; required for deliberate mode transitions.
native.local_timing_evidence.sample_bound_ms: Actual finite>=0 input-polling bound in ms including capture/software schedule, unknown; required only for actual DIGITAL_INPUT POLLED when confirmed, no100ms default.
native.local_timing_evidence.debounce_bound_ms: Actual finite>=0 debounce completion bound, unknown; required only when actual GPIO debounce enabled, not compulsory for every output.
native.local_timing_evidence.edge_detection_bou: Actual finite>=0 input interrupt event/edge detection bound in ms including masking/CPU load, unknown; required only for actual input INTERRUPT.
native.local_timing_evidence.update_bound_ms: Actual finite>=0 output update-to-valid-pin bound in ms at actual load/slew/driver/schedule, unknown; required only for actual DIGITAL_OUTPUT. Input polling cannot substitute for it.

removed.payload_bytes: GPIO digital pin has no intrinsic1-byte frame; any software encoding/remote IO packet belongs to a separately selected transport.
removed.target_bus_load_percent: GPIO pin has no packet bus utilization target60%.
removed.peak_factor: No intrinsic GPIO packet-load peak multiplier1.15.
removed.burst_window_ms: No intrinsic100ms packet-burst analysis window for a local pin.
removed.queue_size: No GPIO packet queue256; software sampling/update queue is actual device/application evidence.
removed.queue_policy: No intrinsic GPIO FIFO scheduling proof.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: No intrinsic GPIO reserved network bandwidth.
removed.packet_loss_probability: Local GPIO pin has no packet-loss process; actual missed samples/edges differ.
removed.bit_error_rate: No intrinsic framed-link bit-error-rate default0; electrical noise/threshold faults need actual model.
removed.corruption_probability: No intrinsic GPIO packet corruption probability0.
removed.duplicate_probability: No intrinsic GPIO duplicated packet probability0; contact bounce is separate actual evidence.
removed.retransmission_enabled: No intrinsic GPIO packet retransmission switch.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No intrinsic GPIO packet retry delay0.
removed.sync_method: GPIO sample scheduling does not imply NTP/PTP or protocol synchronization.
removed.gateway_delay_ms: Local GPIO has no intrinsic gateway forwarding delay0.2ms.
removed.gateway_queue_delay_ms: No intrinsic GPIO gateway packet queue delay0.
removed.protocol_conversion_delay_ms: Pin sampling/driving is not automatically a gateway protocol conversion.
removed.gateway_input_buffer: No intrinsic GPIO gateway256-frame input buffer.
removed.gateway_output_buffer: No intrinsic GPIO gateway256-frame output buffer.

scope: Each original GPIO form parameter, all new actual pin/electrical/role fields and each local timing field reviewed individually. No packet-bus defaults; source-qualified reset exceptions, input/output roles and electrical peer compatibility separate from functional timing.

validation.suite: full_parameter_audit + standard_defaults + profile_semantics + capacity_can_schedule + parameter_review + required_parameters + physical_profiles

not_certified: Actual package pin/mux/threshold/current/aggregate-port/pull/load/glitch/low-power hardware and measurements remain installation facts, not reset proposals
Actual task/interrupt/sample/debounce/update schedule and functional acceptance; GPIO has no packet transport capacity, NOT_APPLICABLE remains
GPIO electrical transient/noise/metastability/contention/EMC/full transfer function and safety acceptance; alternate UART/PWM/ADC/etc require independent explicit technology paths
